claims.quote: The Malabar batasio, Batasio travancoria, is a bagrid catfish endemic to southern Kerala, India, in the Pamba, Chittar and Kallada drainages.
Described from 'Peruntenaruvi', a tributary of the Pamba River in Kottayam district, Kerala state, southwestern India, and also known from the Chittar and Kallada drainages.
